column1: Invasion of New Phyrexia // Teferi Akosa of Zhalfir
column2: Teferi Akosa’s last ability has received an update to its official rules text to clarify its function.
column3: Oracle-wording history: says only that the ability’s rules text was updated (the update is the current Oracle text, which the engine compiles); no statement about how the game plays. The ability’s behavior is tested in tests/rulings/r_p174_resolving.rs (teferi_akosa_taps_creatures_as_it_resolves_then_reflexively_targets).
